applies_why: The judge text does not count any cited-in verse as an unanswered witness; it states the Isaiah 7:14 issue was answered in [CR2] and [CR3].
quote: answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: Because the judge treats the matter as answered, K-G4 forbids counting such a verse as an unanswered witness and the text does not do so.
